en.t: Diocletian orders the church at Nicomedia destroyed
en.s: On February 23, 303, Emperor Diocletian ordered the newly built Christian church at Nicomedia, in present-day Turkey, destroyed, its scriptures burned and its treasures seized. His first general edict against Christians was published the following day.

zh.t: 戴克里先下令拆毁尼科米底亚的教堂
zh.s: 303年2月23日，罗马皇帝戴克里先下令拆毁尼科米底亚新建的基督教堂，焚烧经书并没收财物，地点位于今土耳其境内。他针对基督徒的第一道普遍性敕令在次日公布。

en.t: Justinian begins construction of the present Hagia Sophia
en.s: On February 23, 532, Emperor Justinian I inaugurated construction of the present Hagia Sophia in Constantinople, now Istanbul, Turkey. It replaced a church destroyed during the Nika revolt and was designed by Anthemius of Tralles and Isidore of Miletus.

zh.t: 查士丁尼一世启动现存圣索菲亚大教堂的修建
zh.s: 532年2月23日，皇帝查士丁尼一世在君士坦丁堡，也就是今土耳其伊斯坦布尔，启动现存圣索菲亚大教堂的修建。原来的教堂在尼卡暴动中被烧毁，新教堂由特拉勒斯的安提莫斯和米利都的伊西多尔设计。

en.s: The Battle of Goźlice was a battle which took place on 23 February 1280 near Goźlice (not far from Koprzywnica) where the Polish knights led by the castellan of Kraków, voivodes led by Piotr of Bogoria and Skotnik and Janusz Starż defeated the Tatar-Russian troops led by the Galician-Volhynian prince Leo I of Galicia.

zh.s: 戈兹利采战役于1280年2月23日在戈兹利采附近发生，地点距科普日夫尼察不远。克拉科夫城堡领主率领波兰骑士，彼得·博戈里亚、斯科特尼基和雅努什·斯塔尔日领导诸侯军队，击败了加利西亚—沃里尼亚王公加利西亚的列夫一世率领的鞑靼—罗斯联军。

en.s: The Battle of Ruvo was fought on 23 February 1503 between a Spanish army under Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba and a French army commanded by Jacques de la Palice. The battle was part of the Second Italian War and was fought at the city of Ruvo in the Province of Bari, modern-day Italy. The result was a Spanish victory.

zh.s: 鲁沃战役于1503年2月23日发生，交战双方是贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦率领的西班牙军队和雅克·德·拉帕利斯指挥的法国军队。战役是第二次意大利战争的一部分，地点在今天意大利巴里省的鲁沃市，最终西班牙获胜。

en.s: Battle of Marihueñu was one of the early decisive battles of the Arauco War between the Mapuche leader Lautaro and the Spanish general Francisco de Villagra on 23 February 1554.

zh.s: 1554年2月23日，马普切领袖劳塔罗与西班牙将领弗朗西斯科·德比利亚格拉交战，史称马里韦纽战役。这是阿劳科战争早期的决定性战役之一。

en.t: James FitzMaurice submits, ending the first Desmond rebellion
en.s: On 23 February 1573, James FitzMaurice submitted to the English authorities after negotiating a pardon, ending the first Desmond rebellion in Munster, in present-day Ireland. A later rebellion was a separate phase.

zh.t: 詹姆斯·菲茨莫里斯归顺，第一次德斯蒙德叛乱结束
zh.s: 1573年2月23日，詹姆斯·菲茨莫里斯在谈妥赦免条件后向英国当局归顺，第一次德斯蒙德叛乱随之结束，地点位于今爱尔兰芒斯特地区。后来的第二次叛乱属于另一阶段。

en.s: The Battle of Krasne or the Defense of Krasne (Ukrainian: Битва під Красною, Красненська оборона; Polish: Bitwa pod Krasnem, Obrona Krasny; 20–23 February 1651) was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth against the Cossack Hetmanate as a part of the Khmelnytsky Uprising.

zh.s: 克拉斯涅战役又称克拉斯涅防御战（乌克兰语：Битва під Красною、Красненська оборона；波兰语：Bitwa pod Krasnem、Obrona Krasny），于1651年2月20日至23日进行。交战双方是波兰立陶宛联邦和哥萨克盖特曼国，战役是赫梅利尼茨基起义的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Petschora took place on February 23, 1701 near the village of Pechory, Russia during the second year of the Great Northern War. The Swedish army of about 2,100 men assisted by approximately 2,000 peasants under the command of Jacob Spens defeated a Russian force of about 6,000 men.

zh.s: 1701年2月23日，大北方战争第二年，瑞典军队在俄国佩乔雷村附近击败俄军。雅各布·斯彭斯率领约2100名瑞典士兵，并得到约2000名农民协助；俄军约有6000人。

en.s: The Battle of Ravine-à-Couleuvres (Haitian Creole: Batay Ravin Koulèv), fought on 23 February 1802, was a major battle of the Saint-Domingue expedition during the Haitian Revolution. A French division under General Donatien de Rochambeau was advancing down a ravine (the Ravine-à-Couleuvres), towards Lacroix, Artibonite, where they attacked the army of Toussaint Louverture. Louverture's forces consisted of 1,500 elite grenadiers, 1,000 grenadiers in different Demi-brigades, 400 dragoons.

zh.s: 库勒夫尔山谷战役（海地克里奥尔语：Batay Ravin Koulèv）于1802年2月23日发生，是海地革命期间圣多明各远征中的一场重要战斗。多纳蒂安·德·罗尚博将军率领一支法国部队沿库勒夫尔山谷向阿蒂博尼特省的拉克鲁瓦推进，并在那里袭击杜桑·卢维杜尔的军队。卢维杜尔的部队包括1500名精锐掷弹兵、1000名隶属不同半旅的掷弹兵，以及400名龙骑兵。

en.s: The Battle of Izúcar or the Battle of Izúcar de Matamoros was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred on 23 February 1812 in the area around Izúcar de Matamoros, Puebla. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The Mexican insurgents, who were commended by General Mariano Matamoros y Guridi managed to force the Spanish loyalist forces, commanded by the Brigadier General, Ciriaco del Llano to retreat. It was during this battle that a young Vicente Ramón Guerrero Saldaña, later the president of Mexico, first distinguished himself in battle.

zh.s: 1812年2月23日，墨西哥独立战争期间，普埃布拉州伊苏卡尔德马塔莫罗斯周边发生伊苏卡尔战役，又称伊苏卡尔德马塔莫罗斯战役。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室的保王军，以及争取脱离西班牙帝国的墨西哥起义军。马里亚诺·马塔莫罗斯·伊·古里迪将军率起义军，迫使西里亚科·德尔利亚诺准将指挥的保王军撤退。年轻的比森特·拉蒙·格雷罗·萨尔达尼亚在此战中首次崭露头角，后来成为墨西哥总统。

en.s: The Battle of Mesamávida was a Royalist victory during the Guerra a muerte campaign of the Chilean War of Independence. It was fought on 23 February 1819.

zh.s: 梅萨马维达战役是智利独立战争“殊死战”战役中的一场王党军胜利，于1819年2月23日发生。

en.s: The siege of the Alamo (February 23 – March 6, 1836) was the first thirteen days of the Battle of the Alamo. On February 23, Mexican troops under General Antonio Lopez de Santa Anna entered San Antonio de Bexar, Texas, and surrounded the Alamo Mission. The Alamo was defended by a small force of Texians and Tejanos, led by William Barrett Travis and James Bowie, and included Davy Crockett.

zh.s: 阿拉莫围城战于1836年2月23日至3月6日进行，是阿拉莫战役的前13天。2月23日，安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳将军率领墨西哥军队进入得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥德贝克萨尔，并包围阿拉莫传道院。守军人数不多，由威廉·巴雷特·特拉维斯和詹姆斯·鲍伊率领，其中包括戴维·克罗克特。

en.s: The 1837 Anglesey by-election was a parliamentary by-election held for the UK House of Commons constituency of Anglesey in North Wales on 23 February 1837.

zh.s: 1837年2月23日，英国下议院位于北威尔士的安格尔西选区举行议会补选。

en.t: Chochołów insurgents surrender after a renewed attack
en.s: On 23 February 1846, a renewed attack by Austrian border guards and peasants from Czarny Dunajec forced the Chochołów insurgents to surrender, in present-day Poland. The uprising had begun on February 21.

zh.t: 霍霍武夫起义者在再次遭袭后投降
zh.s: 1846年2月23日，奥地利边防卫兵和来自恰尔内杜纳耶茨的农民再次进攻，迫使霍霍武夫起义者投降，地点位于今波兰境内。这场起义于2月21日开始。

en.s: The Battle of Buena Vista (February 22–23, 1847), known as the Battle of La Angostura in Mexico, and sometimes as Battle of Buena Vista/La Angostura, was a battle of the Mexican–American War. It was fought between U.S. forces, largely volunteers, under General Zachary Taylor, and the much larger Mexican Army under General Antonio López de Santa Anna.
en.n: Mexican–American War: Battle of Buena Vista: In Mexico, American troops under future president General Zachary Taylor defeat Mexican General Antonio López de Santa Anna.

zh.s: 布埃纳维斯塔战役于1847年2月22日至23日发生，是美墨战争中的一场战斗。在墨西哥，这场战役称为拉安戈斯图拉战役，有时也称布埃纳维斯塔／拉安戈斯图拉战役。交战双方是扎卡里·泰勒将军率领的美军（主要由志愿兵组成）和安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳将军率领、规模大得多的墨西哥军队。
zh.n: 美墨战争：布埃纳维斯塔战役期间，扎卡里·泰勒将军率领的美军在墨西哥击败安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳将军率领的墨西哥军队。

en.t: Britain recognizes Orange Free State independence
en.s: On 23 February 1854, the Orange River Convention was signed at Bloemfontein in present-day South Africa, recognizing the independence of the Orange Free State and ending British sovereignty over the territory.

zh.t: 英国承认奥兰治自由邦独立
zh.s: 1854年2月23日，《奥兰治河协定》在今南非布隆方丹签署，英国承认奥兰治自由邦独立，并结束对该地区的主权管辖。

en.s: The 1871 New Zealand general election was held between 14 January and 23 February to elect 78 MPs across 72 electorates to the fifth session of the New Zealand Parliament. 41,527 electors were registered.

zh.s: 1871年新西兰大选于1月14日至2月23日举行，选出第五届新西兰议会的78名议员，分属72个选区。登记选民人数为41,527人。

en.s: The 1884 Scottish Cup Final was scheduled to be the 11th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1883–84 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. Six-time winners Queen's Park were due to face three-time winners Vale of Leven at Cathkin Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 23 February 1884.

zh.s: 1884年苏格兰杯决赛原定于2月23日在克罗斯希尔的卡思金公园举行，由六届冠军女王公园对阵三届冠军利文谷。这原本将是第11届决赛，也是1883—84赛季这项苏格兰最具声望的足球淘汰赛的最后一场比赛。克罗斯希尔如今属于格拉斯哥。

en.s: The Battle of Đồng Đăng (23 February 1885) was an important French victory during the Sino-French War. The battle formed part of the French advance following the Lạng Sơn campaign and resulted in the temporary expulsion of Chinese forces from the Tonkin border region. After the battle, French forces destroyed the Gate of China at Zhennan Pass before withdrawing back toward Lạng Sơn. Three weeks later Chinese forces counterattacked, leading to the events that culminated in the Battle of Bang Bo. It is named after the town of Đồng Đăng, then in northern Tonkin, close to the border between China and Vietnam.

zh.s: 1885年2月23日的同登战役，是中法战争期间法国取得的一场重要胜利。法军在谅山战役后继续推进，暂时将清军逐出东京地区的边境地带。战后，法军摧毁镇南关关门，随后撤回谅山方向。三周后，清军反攻，一系列战事最终发展为邦博战役，也就是镇南关之战。同登战役以当时东京北部、中越边境附近的同登镇命名。

en.t: Charles Martin Hall obtains aluminium by electrolysis
en.s: On February 23, 1886, Charles Martin Hall produced aluminium by passing an electric current through alumina dissolved in molten cryolite in the United States. His sister Julia Brainerd Hall helped with the experiments.

zh.t: 查尔斯·马丁·霍尔通过电解制得铝
zh.s: 1886年2月23日，查尔斯·马丁·霍尔在美国将电流通入溶有氧化铝的熔融冰晶石，制得铝。他的姐姐朱莉娅·布雷纳德·霍尔参与协助实验。

en.s: The 1887 Liguria earthquake struck off the coast of Imperia, Italy on the early morning of 23 February 1887, with an estimated moment magnitude of 6.8–6.9, killing about 600–3,000 people. It also generated a tsunami that had a run-up height of two meters. The widespread damage was said to be so severe that the town of Bussana Vecchia was abandoned by its former inhabitants.

zh.s: 1887年2月23日清晨，意大利因佩里亚外海发生地震，估计矩震级为6.8至6.9，造成约600至3000人死亡。地震还引发海啸，海水爬升高度达到两米。据记载，破坏范围广且程度严重，旧布萨纳镇居民因此放弃原居地。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Cirencester was held on 23 February 1893 after a court declared that votes in the by-election in 1892 had been declared equal. The seat was gained by the Liberal candidate Harry Levy-Lawson. The Conservative candidate Thomas Chester-Master was declared the victor of the 1892 by-election by 3 votes, but on petition and after scrutiny, the votes were declared equal and the 1893 by-election was held.

zh.s: 1893年2月23日，英国议会赛伦塞斯特选区举行补选。法院认定1892年该选区补选的票数相同，因此重新投票。自由党候选人哈里·利维-劳森赢得席位。保守党候选人托马斯·切斯特-马斯特曾以3票优势被宣布赢得1892年补选，但在请愿并重新核查选票后，法院裁定双方票数相同，因此于1893年举行补选。

en.t: Edwin Jorden begins his brief term in the US House of Representatives
en.s: On February 23, 1895, Edwin Jorden began serving in the US House of Representatives for Pennsylvania’s 15th district. He filled the vacancy caused by Myron Wright’s death and served until March 4.

zh.t: 埃德温·乔登开始担任美国众议员
zh.s: 1895年2月23日，埃德温·乔登开始代表宾夕法尼亚州第十五选区担任美国众议员，填补迈伦·赖特去世后留下的席位。他的任期仅持续到3月4日。

en.s: The Taunton by-election of 1909 was held on 23 February 1909. The by-election was held due to the ill health of the incumbent Conservative MP, Edward Boyle. It was won by the Conservative candidate William Wellesley Peel, previously the MP for Manchester South.

zh.s: 1909年2月23日，英国汤顿选区举行补选，原因是现任保守党议员爱德华·博伊尔健康不佳。曾任曼彻斯特南选区议员的保守党候选人威廉·韦尔斯利·皮尔当选。

en.s: The Second Battle of Kut was fought on 23 February 1917, between British and Ottoman forces at Kut, Mesopotamia (present-day Iraq). The battle was part of the British advance to Baghdad begun in December 1916 by a 50,000-man British force (mainly from British India) organised in two army corps. The British, led by Frederick Stanley Maude, recaptured the city, but the Ottoman garrison there did not get trapped inside (as had happened to Townshend's troops in the previous year when the Ottomans had besieged Kut in the Siege of Kut): the Ottoman commander, Kâzım Karabekir Bey, managed a good-order retreat from the town of his remaining soldiers (about 2,500), pursued by a British fluvial flotilla along the Tigris River.

zh.s: 1917年2月23日，英军与奥斯曼军在美索不达米亚，也就是今伊拉克的库特交战。此战属于英军向巴格达推进的行动。1916年12月起，主要来自英属印度的5万名英军编为两个军，开始进攻。弗雷德里克·斯坦利·莫德率军夺回库特，但奥斯曼守军没有像前一年在库特之围中的汤森部队那样被困城内。奥斯曼指挥官卡泽姆·卡拉贝基尔贝伊率剩余约2500名士兵有序撤离，英国内河舰队沿底格里斯河追击。

en.s: Kaunas garrison mutiny (Lithuanian: Kauno įgulos maištas) or Panemunė rebellion (Lithuanian: Panemunės sukilimas) was a failed mutiny of Lithuanian soldiers stationed in Kaunas on 22–23 February 1920. The Lithuanian Army was established in December 1918 and successfully pushed out the Bolsheviks (see the Lithuanian–Soviet War) and the Bermontians (see the Lithuanian–Bermontian War) by the end of 1919.

zh.s: 考纳斯驻军哗变（立陶宛语：Kauno įgulos maištas）又称帕内穆内叛乱（立陶宛语：Panemunės sukilimas），是立陶宛驻考纳斯士兵于1920年2月22日至23日发动的一次未遂哗变。立陶宛军队于1918年12月建立，并在1919年底前成功击退布尔什维克（见立陶宛—苏联战争）和别尔蒙特军队（见立陶宛—别尔蒙特战争）。

en.s: The 1922 Bodmin by-election was a parliamentary by-election for the British House of Commons. The constituency of Bodmin in Cornwall polled on 23 February 1922. The by-election was notable for the opposition Liberal Party gaining a seat from the Coalition-supporting Conservative Party.

zh.s: 1922年2月23日，英国康沃尔郡博德明选区举行下议院补选。此次选举中，在野的自由党从支持联合政府的保守党手中夺得议席，因此受到关注。

en.s: The 1930 Dominican coup d'état was the military coup that took place in the Dominican Republic on February 23, 1930 when the Dominican Army, led by Rafael Trujillo, overthrew President Horacio Vasquez. Trujillo seized power, cemented his power in a rigged May 1930 election, establishing a military dictatorship that would last 31 years. Trujillo plotted with the Coalicion Patriotica de Ciudadanos, the main opposition party, against the Vasquez government.

zh.s: 1930年2月23日，拉斐尔·特鲁希略率多米尼加军队发动军事政变，推翻总统奥拉西奥·巴斯克斯。特鲁希略此前与主要反对党公民爱国联盟合谋反对巴斯克斯政府。他夺权后，通过1930年5月遭操纵的选举巩固统治，建立了延续31年的军事独裁。

en.t: Leopold III succeeds Albert I as King of the Belgians
en.s: On February 23, 1934, Leopold III succeeded Albert I as King of the Belgians. Albert I had died six days earlier. This date marks Leopold’s accession rather than his father’s death.

zh.t: 利奥波德三世继任比利时国王
zh.s: 1934年2月23日，利奥波德三世继任比利时国王。他的父亲阿尔贝一世于六天前去世，此条记录的是利奥波德三世继位的日期。

en.t: Soviet volunteer airmen bomb Songshan airfield in Taiwan
en.s: On February 23, 1938, Soviet volunteer airmen supporting China attacked Songshan airfield near Taipei in Taiwan, then under Japanese rule. The raid used SB bombers against a base supporting Japanese operations in China.
en.n: The February 23 Soviet volunteer raid is distinguished from the conflicting February 8 account in the retained English article.

zh.t: 苏联援华航空志愿队空袭台湾松山机场
zh.s: 1938年2月23日，苏联援华航空志愿队使用SB轰炸机空袭当时受日本统治的台湾台北松山机场。日军曾以该机场为基地，支援在中国的作战。
zh.n: 此条记录2月23日苏联志愿队的空袭，与保留的英文原文中日期为2月8日的记载作了区分。

en.s: The Battle of Dubovychi took place as a result of the attack launched by the German forces on the partisan-held settlement as part of the punitive operation against the Soviet partisans, on 23 February 1942.

zh.s: 1942年2月23日，德军袭击由苏联游击队控制的杜博维奇村，随后爆发战斗。这次袭击是德军惩罚苏联游击队行动的一部分。

en.t: Japanese submarine shells Ellwood oil facilities in California
en.s: On February 23, 1942, the Japanese submarine I-17 shelled the Ellwood oil field near Santa Barbara, California, United States. The attack caused limited damage and heightened fear of further attacks on the US West Coast.

zh.t: 日军潜艇炮击加利福尼亚州埃尔伍德油田
zh.s: 1942年2月23日，日军伊-17号潜艇炮击美国加利福尼亚州圣巴巴拉附近的埃尔伍德油田，造成有限破坏，也加剧了美国西海岸对再次遭袭的担忧。

en.s: The Cavan Orphanage fire occurred on the night of 23 February 1943 at St Joseph's Orphanage in Cavan, Ireland. 35 children and one adult employee died as a result. All of the lay teachers and nuns survived the fire. Much of the attention after the fire surrounded the role of the Poor Clares, the order of nuns who ran the orphanage, and the local fire service.

zh.s: 1943年2月23日夜，爱尔兰卡文的圣若瑟孤儿院发生火灾，造成35名儿童和1名成年雇员死亡。所有非神职教师与修女均生还。事后，经营孤儿院的贫穷圣嘉勒修女会，以及当地消防部门在事件中的责任，成为关注焦点。

en.t: Greek Resistance: The United Panhellenic Organization of Youth is founded in Greece
en.s: The United Panhellenic Organization of Youth, abbreviated EPON (Greek: Ενιαία Πανελλαδική Οργάνωση Νέων – ΕΠΟΝ), was a Greek resistance organization that was active during the Axis Occupation of Greece in World War II. EPON was the youth wing of the National Liberation Front (EAM) organization, and was established on 23 February 1943 after the merger of ten earlier political and resistance youth organizations.

zh.t: 希腊抵抗运动：泛希腊青年联合组织在希腊成立
zh.s: 泛希腊青年联合组织简称EPON（希腊语：Ενιαία Πανελλαδική Οργάνωση Νέων – ΕΠΟΝ），是第二次世界大战轴心国占领希腊期间活动的希腊抵抗组织。它是民族解放阵线（EAM）的青年组织，于1943年2月23日由此前成立的十个政治及抵抗青年组织合并而成。

en.s: The Soviet government forcibly transferred the whole of the Vainakh (Chechen and Ingush) populations of the North Caucasus to Central Asia on 23 February 1944, during World War II. The expulsion, referred to by Chechens often as Aardakh (the Exodus), was ordered by NKVD chief Lavrentiy Beria after approval by Soviet leader and dictator Joseph Stalin as part of a Soviet forced settlement program and population transfer that affected several million members of ethnic minorities in the Soviet Union between the 1930s and the 1950s.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，苏联政府于1944年2月23日强行将北高加索的瓦伊纳赫人（车臣人和印古什人）全部迁往中亚。车臣人常称这次驱逐为“Aardakh”（意为“出走”）。行动由苏联内务人民委员部负责人拉夫连季·贝利亚下令，并经苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林批准，是苏联在20世纪30至50年代实施的一系列强制安置和人口迁移行动之一；这些行动影响了数百万少数民族居民。

en.s: The Battle of the Admin Box (sometimes referred to as the Battle of Ngakyedauk or the Battle of Sinzweya) took place on the southern front of the Burma campaign from 5 to 23 February 1944, in the South-East Asian Theatre of World War II. Japanese forces attempted a local counter-attack against an Allied offensive with the aim of drawing Allied reserves from the Central Front in Assam, where the Japanese were preparing their own major offensive.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 行政箱战役又称恩加基达乌克战役或辛泽韦亚战役，于1944年2月5日至23日在第二次世界大战东南亚战区缅甸战役南部战线进行。日军试图局部反攻盟军，目的是调走阿萨姆中央战线的盟军预备队；日军正在那里准备发动大规模攻势。

en.s: The Battle of Eniwetok was a battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought from 17 to 23 February 1944 on Enewetak Atoll in the Marshall Islands. The invasion of Eniwetok followed the American success in the Battle of Kwajalein to the southeast. Capture of Eniwetok would provide an airfield and harbor to support attacks on the Mariana Islands to the northwest.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃尼威托克战役是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场战斗，于1944年2月17日至23日在马绍尔群岛的埃内韦塔克环礁进行。美军在东南方向的夸贾林战役中获胜后，开始进攻埃尼威托克。占领该地可为支援西北方向的马里亚纳群岛攻势提供机场和港口。

en.s: The Raid on Los Baños (Filipino: Pagsalakay sa Los Baños) in the Philippines, early Friday morning on 23 February 1945, was executed by a combined United States Army Airborne and Filipino guerrilla task force, resulting in the liberation of 2,147 Allied civilian and military internees from an agricultural school campus turned Japanese internment camp.

zh.t: 洛斯巴尼奥斯营救行动
zh.s: 1945年2月23日星期五清晨，美国陆军空降部队与菲律宾游击队组成联合特遣队，在菲律宾实施洛斯巴尼奥斯突袭行动。他们从一所被日军改作拘禁营的农业学校校园中，救出2147名被拘禁的盟国平民和军人。

en.t: Bombing of Pforzheim in World War II
en.s: During the latter stages of World War II, Pforzheim, a town in southwestern Germany, was bombed several times. The largest raid, one of the most devastating area bombardments of the war, was carried out by the Royal Air Force (RAF) on the evening of February 23, 1945. Some 17,600 people, or 31.4% of the town's population, were killed.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战期间普福尔茨海姆遭轰炸
zh.s: 第二次世界大战后期，德国西南部城镇普福尔茨海姆多次遭到轰炸。1945年2月23日晚，英国皇家空军发动最大规模的一次空袭，也是战争中破坏最严重的区域轰炸之一。约17,600人死亡，占该镇人口的31.4%。

en.t: The last German defenders at Poznań’s citadel surrender
en.s: On February 23, 1945, the last German units defending the citadel in Poznań, Poland, surrendered. The fall of the citadel ended the main battle for the city after a month of fighting.

zh.t: 波兹南城堡最后的德军守军投降
zh.s: 1945年2月23日，波兰波兹南城堡最后的德军守军投降。这座城堡的失守，标志着持续约一个月的波兹南主要战斗结束。

en.t: Operation Clarion reaches the end of its two-day bombing campaign
en.s: On February 23, 1945, Operation Clarion reached the end of its stated two-day bombing period in Germany. Allied aircraft attacked transport infrastructure, including railway stations, bridges and waterways.

zh.s: 1945年2月23日，盟军在德国实施的“号角行动”结束了资料所载的两天空袭。空袭目标包括铁路车站、桥梁和水路运输设施。

en.t: American Airlines Flight 009 crashes near Rural Retreat, Virginia, killing 17
en.s: American Airlines Flight 009 was a flight from New York City to Los Angeles. On the morning of February 23, 1945, while flying over Rural Retreat, Virginia, on the Washington-Nashville leg, the Douglas DC-3 struck the wooded summit of Glade Mountain in the Appalachian Mountains, killing 17 of the 22 occupants on board.

zh.t: 美国航空009号航班坠毁，17人遇难
zh.s: 美国航空009号航班从纽约飞往洛杉矶。1945年2月23日上午，该航班飞经弗吉尼亚州乡村静居镇上空，正执行华盛顿至纳什维尔航段时，所乘道格拉斯DC-3撞上阿巴拉契亚山脉格莱德山的林木覆盖山顶。机上22人中有17人遇难。

en.t: American photographer Joe Rosenthal took the Pulitzer Prize–winning photograph Raising the Flag on Iwo Jima during the Battle of Iwo Jima, an image that was later reproduced on the Marine Corps War Memorial
en.s: Raising the Flag on Iwo Jima (Japanese: 硫黄島の星条旗, Hepburn: Iōjima no Seijōki) is a photograph of six United States Marines raising the U.S. flag atop Mount Suribachi during the Battle of Iwo Jima in the final stages of the Pacific War. Taken by Joe Rosenthal of the Associated Press on February 23, 1945, the photograph was published in Sunday newspapers two days later and reprinted in thousands of publications.

zh.t: 乔·罗森塔尔拍下《硫磺岛升旗》
zh.s: 《硫磺岛升旗》（日语：硫黄島の星条旗，罗马字：Iōjima no Seijōki）是一张照片，记录了六名美国海军陆战队员在太平洋战争末期的硫磺岛战役期间，将美国国旗升到折钵山顶的场景。美联社摄影师乔·罗森塔尔于1945年2月23日拍下这张照片。两天后，照片刊登在周日版报纸上，之后被数千种出版物转载。

en.t: International Organization for Standardization is founded
en.s: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO), (the preferred official pronunciation of the organizational name is: US: ) is an independent, non-governmental, international standard development organization composed of representatives from the national standards organizations of member countries. Membership requirements are given in Article 3 of the ISO Statutes. ISO was founded on 23 February 1947, and it has published over 25,000 international standards as of July 2024, covering almost all aspects of technology and manufacturing.

zh.s: 国际标准化组织（ISO）是一个独立的非政府国际标准制定组织，由成员国的国家标准机构代表组成。会员资格要求载于《ISO章程》第三条。ISO于1947年2月23日成立；截至2024年7月，已发布超过25,000项国际标准，涉及技术和制造业几乎所有领域。

en.s: The 1950 United Kingdom general election was the first ever general election to be held after a full term of a Labour government. The election was held on 23 February 1950. Despite polling over one and a half million votes more than the Conservatives, and receiving more votes than they had during the 1945 election, Labour obtained a slim majority of just five seats — a stark contrast to 1945, when they had achieved a 146-seat majority. Labour called another general election in 1951.

zh.s: 1950年2月23日的英国大选，是工党政府首次完成一个完整任期后举行的大选。工党总得票比保守党多150多万，也高于自身1945年的得票，但在议会仅取得5席的微弱多数，与1945年146席的多数优势形成鲜明对比。工党于1951年再次举行大选。

en.s: The Battle of Nan'ao island (Nan'ao Dao, 南澳岛战斗/南澳島戰鬥) took place between the nationalists (Kuomintang) and the communists. Nan'ao Island (Nan'ao Dao, 南澳岛) of Swatow (now known as Shantou) remained in the nationalist hands after Guangdong fell into communist hands. On February 23, 1950, the 121st division of the 41st Army of the People's Liberation Army attacked the island.

en.s: On 23 February 1950, the 1950 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 625 members of the House of Commons, including the 12 Northern Ireland seats. en.s: On Thursday 23 February 1950, the 1950 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 625 members of the House of Commons, with 506 constituencies being in England. en.t: Insurgents attack the Bukit Kepong police station
en.s: On 23 February 1950, communist insurgents attacked the Bukit Kepong police station in Johor, Malaya, in present-day Malaysia. Police and their families were caught in the assault, and the station was burned.

en.t: Juan Manuel Fangio is kidnapped in Havana
en.s: On February 23, 1958, members of Cuba’s 26th of July Movement kidnapped racing driver Juan Manuel Fangio from the Hotel Lincoln in Havana, Cuba. The kidnapping occurred before the Cuban Grand Prix, rather than on the race day itself.

en.t: Fire Support Base Hotel 2 comes under attack during Lam Son 719
en.s: On February 23, 1971, Fire Support Base Hotel 2, south of Route 9 in Laos, came under an intense artillery and infantry attack during Operation Lam Son 719. This was one phase of the longer campaign.

zh.s: 1971年2月23日，老挝九号公路以南的Hotel 2火力支援基地遭到猛烈的炮火和步兵攻击。这是蓝山719行动中的一场战斗，并非整个行动的开始或结束。

en.s: The February 1977 Israeli Labor Party leadership election was held on 23 February 1977. It saw the delegates to the party's convention reelect Yitzhak Rabin as the party's leader. en.s: The Battle of Gayaza Hills or the Battle of Kajurungusi (Kiswahili: Mapigano ya Kajurungusi) was a conflict of the Uganda–Tanzania War that took place in late February 1979 around the Gayaza Hills and Lake Nakivale in southern Uganda, near the town of Gayaza. Tanzanian troops attacked the Ugandan positions in the hills, and though suffering heavy casualties in an ambush, they successfully captured the area by the end of the day. Colonel Idi Amin had seized power in a military coup in Uganda in 1971 and established a repressive dictatorship. Seven years later he attempted to invade Tanzania to the south. Ugandan troops occupied the Kagera Salient and subsequently murdered local civilians and destroyed property. The attack was eventually repulsed, and Tanzanian President Julius Nyerere, unsatisfied with Amin's refusal to renounce his claims to Tanzanian territory and the international community's failure to strongly condemn the invasion, ordered his forces to advance into southern Uganda with the aim of capturing the towns of Masaka and Mbarara. Between Mbarara and the Tanzanian border were the Gayaza Hills, which overlooked Lake Nakivale. Retreating Ugandan troops occupied them, and on 21 or 23 February 1979 the Tanzanian 206th Brigade attacked their positions.

zh.s: 加亚扎丘陵战役，又称卡朱伦古西战役，是乌干达—坦桑尼亚战争的一场战斗，于1979年2月下旬发生在乌干达南部加亚扎镇附近的丘陵与纳基瓦莱湖一带。坦桑尼亚军队进攻乌军山地阵地，虽在伏击中伤亡惨重，仍在当天结束前夺取该地区。伊迪·阿明上校于1971年通过军事政变控制乌干达，建立高压独裁统治。七年后，他试图入侵南方的坦桑尼亚，乌军占领卡盖拉突出部，杀害当地平民并破坏财产，最终被击退。阿明拒绝放弃对坦桑尼亚领土的要求，国际社会也未强烈谴责入侵，坦桑尼亚总统朱利叶斯·尼雷尔对此不满，下令军队进入乌干达南部，夺取马萨卡和姆巴拉拉。加亚扎丘陵位于姆巴拉拉与坦桑尼亚边境之间，俯瞰纳基瓦莱湖。撤退的乌军占据丘陵，坦桑尼亚第206旅于1979年2月21日或23日向其阵地进攻。

en.s: A coup d'état was attempted in Spain in February 1981 by right-wing, Francoist elements of the Civil Guard and the Spanish military. The failure of the coup marked the last serious attempt to revert Spain to a Francoist state and served to consolidate Spain's democratization process. King Juan Carlos I played a major role in foiling the coup, and the monarchy emerged with renewed legitimacy as a result. The coup, which became known in Spain as 23F, began on 23 February 1981 when Lieutenant-Colonel Antonio Tejero, along with 200 armed Civil Guard officers, stormed the Congress of Deputies chamber in Madrid during a vote to swear in Leopoldo Calvo-Sotelo as President of the Government.

en.s: A by-election was held in the Richmond (Yorks) constituency of the United Kingdom Parliament on 23 February 1989. It followed the resignation of the sitting Conservative Member of Parliament (MP) Leon Brittan on 31 December 1988, to allow him to take up the position of Vice-President of the European Commission. en.s: The Galtür avalanche occurred on 23 February 1999 in the Alpine village of Galtür, Austria. At 50 m (160 ft) high and traveling at 290 km/h (180 mph), the powder avalanche overturned cars, destroyed buildings and buried 57 people. By the time rescue crews managed to arrive, 31 people had died. It was considered the worst Alpine avalanche in 40 years.

en.s: General elections were held in Uganda on 23 February 2006. They were the first multi-party elections since President Yoweri Museveni took over power in 1986, and followed a referendum the previous year on scrapping the ban on party politics. en.s: The Grayrigg derailment was a fatal railway accident that occurred at approximately 20:15 GMT on 23 February 2007, just to the south of Grayrigg, Cumbria, in the North West England region of the United Kingdom. The initial conclusion of the accident investigation is that the derailment was caused by a faulty set of points (number 2B) on the Down Main running line, controlled from Lambrigg ground frame. The scheduled inspection on 18 February 2007 had not taken place and the faults had gone undetected. Although the accident killed far fewer people than some other accidents on the West Coast Main Line, it had a major negative impact on Network Rail's safety record.

zh.t: 格雷里格列车脱轨事故

en.s: In November 2016, the Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) held an election which saw Jose "Peping" Cojuangco win a fourth term as president after Victorico "Ricky" Vargas was disqualified for not being an "active member" of the committee. Tolentino, a candidate for the chairman position was also disqualified on the same grounds. The camp of Vargas said that being an active member does not equate to physical attendance which the POC led by then incumbent President Cojuangco insists. This led to Vargas to seek a temporary restraining order to stop the 2016 elections and rule on the POC's commission on election's authority to define the eligibility criteria of being an active member. The court denied postponing the 2016 elections but it ruled in December 2017 that the commission on elections of the POC cannot qualify or restrict the criteria of being an active member, ruled that the results of the 2016 elections for the post of President and Chairman null and void, and ordered the POC to hold elections on February 23, 2018 with Vargas and Tolentino as candidates.

Despite losses, the SPD remained comfortably in first place with 39% of votes. The Greens doubled their vote share to 24%, becoming the second largest party in the state Parliament for the first time.

en.s: A federal election was held in Germany on 23 February 2025 to elect the 630 members of the 21st Bundestag, down from 736 in 2021 due to reforms in seat distribution. The 2025 election took place seven months ahead of schedule due to the 2024 collapse of the Scholz governing coalition. Following the loss of his majority, the chancellor called and intentionally lost a motion of confidence, which enabled the approval of a new election by the president. The 2025 election was the fourth snap election in post-war German history. Three opposition parties increased their share of votes in the election, compared with the previous federal election in 2021.

zh.s: 德国于2025年2月23日举行联邦选举，选出第21届联邦议院630名议员。由于议席分配制度改革，议员人数从2021年的736人减少到630人。朔尔茨联合政府在2024年瓦解，使选举比原定时间提前七个月。失去多数支持后，总理主动提出信任投票，并有意让投票失败，以便总统批准重新选举。这是战后德国第四次提前举行联邦选举。与2021年相比，有三个反对党的得票率上升。
